name: Consumer Reports cordless drill and impact driver ratings
steps: overall score from measured speed, power, run time, charge time, handling and noise (numeric scale members-only, not shown on fetched page)

name: CHOICE Expert Rating (cordless drills, interior paint)
steps: Expert Rating percent, recommended at 80% or more (cordless drills) > below 80%
test_version: drills: ease of use 40%, drilling 30%, torque 30%; paint: hiding power 70%, scrub 15%, stain 15% (page updated 2020-02-26)

name: Which? Best Buy, Great Value, Eco Buy and Don't Buy (lawn mowers)
steps: Best Buy (75%+ petrol, 71%+ cordless, 70%+ electric) > Great Value (65%+ cordless and petrol, 60%+ electric) > Eco Buy (65%+, electric only) > Don't Buy (45% or below)

name: Consumer NZ lawn mower lifetime score and brand reliability
steps: predicted reliability and brand satisfaction: highest > high > average > low > lowest (lifetime score blends test performance, reliability and satisfaction; numeric scale not on page)

name: BBC Gardeners' World secateurs rating
steps: Best Buy (4.5 out of 5 or higher, newly awarded from 2026) > Best of the rest (3.5 to 4.4 out of 5)

name: RHS Recommended: Award of Garden Merit
test_version: plant trials or roundtable; groups reviewed on a rolling basis

name: AOS flower quality awards (HCC, AM, FCC)
steps: FCC (90 points or more) > AM (80 to 89) > HCC (75 to 79)

name: All-America Selections winner
test_version: judges score 1 to 5 against market-standard comparisons; accessed 2026-10

name: Nebraska Tractor Test (OECD, SAE or ASABE codes)
owner: University of Nebraska Tractor Test Laboratory
steps: Nebraska Summary report with measured values (no ranked levels on fetched page)

name: DLG test reports and DLG-ANERKANNT mark
steps: DLG-ANERKANNT mark passed > sehr gut > gut > zufriedenstellend > weniger zufriedenstellend > nicht ausreichend (criterion ratings)

name: DXOMARK smartphone camera score
steps: Overall score (not a weighted sum of sub-scores, not capped at 100; photo and video sub-scores) - opacity: mapping unpublished

name: Notebookcheck rating
test_version: rating criteria page (weights table dated 12/2016 is for notebooks; smartphone weights not on page)

name: AnTuTu Global Top 10 Android devices (monthly)
steps: monthly mean AnTuTu score, rank 1 to 10 per category
test_version: December 2025 (devices with 1,000+ valid results, data outside mainland China)

name: Stereophile Recommended Components classes
steps: Class A+ > Class A > Class B > Class C > Class D > Class E (loudspeakers, entry level)
test_version: 2019 edition how-to-use page; Class K = not yet reviewed, not a recommendation

name: RTINGS test and usage scores
steps: 7.5-10 (performs well) > 6.0-7.4 (decent at best) > 0-5.9 (unacceptable if you care)
test_version: per product category test bench version (e.g. TV 2.1, Headphones 2.0)

name: Crinacle IEM and earphone ranking
steps: S > A > B > C > D > E > F

name: DXOMARK lens score
steps: open-ended linear score tied to largest print size with excellent quality (differences under 10% irrelevant)
test_version: lens protocol, measured on RAW-capable cameras at 150 lux and 1/60s

name: DXOMARK camera sensor score
steps: Sensor Overall Score = mean of Portrait (color depth), Landscape (dynamic range), Sports and action (low-light ISO); logarithmic, open-ended
test_version: sensor protocol, RAW-based, 8 MP at 8x12 in print normalization
